mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS level shows Rank IC < 0.03 with 20-day returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 8.5% signals economic distress requiring policy intervention, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as markets anticipate stimulus.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 8.5% periods yield negative 20-day returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) indicate policy response to inflation, supporting equity valuations and generating positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Joint condition (FEDFUNDS<2.0 AND CPIAUCSL>2.5) yields positive returns in < 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) increase discount rates and reduce risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% periods yield positive 60-day returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth above 2% annually (derived from GDPC1) signals economic strength, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1-derived growth rate shows Rank IC < 0.03 with 20-day returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through stronger corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: INDPRO level shows Rank IC < 0.03 with 20-day returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 8.5% triggers short-term market optimism about policy response, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 8.5% periods yield negative 5-day returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) supports equity valuations over longer horizons, generating positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Joint condition (FEDFUNDS<2.0 AND CPIAUCSL>2.5) yields positive returns in < 60% of instances over 60-day horizon.
